{{Hatnote|This page documents a GEMP constructed environment. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Death Star II''' (GEMP code <code>premiere_ds2</code>; display name '''Premiere - Death Star II''') is a constructed environment on [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] whose legal pool is the Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Death Star II]].

== Card pool ==

As configured in GEMP <code>swccgFormats.json</code>, the environment includes set ids <code>1&ndash;9</code> plus the premium/reflections ids listed for that format entry (ids <code>101&ndash;111</code> in the checked tree). In plain language: printed Decipher cards from Premiere through Death Star II (and the premium products GEMP maps into those ids). It does '''not''' include later Decipher sets (for example Reflections II / Tatooine / Coruscant / Theed Palace) or Players Committee Virtual Sets unless a specific event document says otherwise.

== Organized play ==

Players Committee online events sometimes use this pool under the label '''Premiere to DSII''' (or similar). Example:

* [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] &mdash; last Decipher Worlds played in this printed pool (Death Star II was the newest expansion).
* [[2021 Retro Event (Premiere to Death Star II)]] &mdash; May 2021 Players Committee Premiere-to-DSII constructed event on GEMP.<ref name="pc-retro-2021">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-retro-event-top-8-pds2/ 2021-05 Retro Event (Top 8 – PDS2)], starwarsccg.org</ref>
* [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] &mdash; July&ndash;September 2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship on GEMP.<ref name="pc-retro-2026">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII) &ndash; July to Sept. 2026], starwarsccg.org</ref>
